description: How the aidrian plugin is built, checked, versioned, and changed: its agents, skills, hooks, commands, and project-folder contract.

working-agreement.md.summary: Rules every change here keeps: worktrees, generated agents, tests, hooks failing open, docs, version bumps, the knowledge index.

contributing.md.summary: Building and checking the plugin: npm run build and check, what the tests hold, trying a branch, skill evals, version bumps.

architecture.md.summary: Repository layout and how agents-src, providers, generated agents, skills, hooks, lib, and the aidrian command connect.

agent-sources.md.summary: Editing the plugin's agents: group folders, neutral fields, provider files, addon merge order, adding a provider.

agents-and-skills.md.summary: The catalog of every agent and skill the plugin ships, grouped; tests hold it in sync with agents-src folders.

hooks.md.summary: Plugin hooks and Bash rules: pr-body, main-checkout, review-gate, review-rounds, process-kill, git-amend, terms, agent gates, commit messages.

project-folder.md.summary: The .aidrian/ folder: aidrian init, check, and lint, the local state folder, task worktrees, local knowledge sources, migrating.

review.md.summary: aidrian pr review: review plan, splits, critical flows and invariants, visual review, reviewers, review rounds and their limit, sign-off.

knowledge.md.summary: Knowledge buckets: index file format, tags, shaping buckets, overrides, project agents, aidrian-knowledge commands, checks.

lessons.md.summary: Lesson inbox and aidrian lesson add, list, resolve, stats: tiers, kinds, targets, outcomes, automatic lessons from repeated hook blocks.

config.md.summary: config.json keys: pull request title and body sections, review plan and gate, terms, models and effort, names, attribution, telemetry.

dispatch-log.md.summary: Dispatch log rows (dispatch, stop, session, hook_deny) and aidrian report: costs, tokens, doc reads, reviews, health thresholds.

adopting.md.summary: Finishing a project's setup: shaping buckets, pointing the main session at them, team install, review bot, first check.

design/project-rules.md.summary: Design for the pull request contract, review gate, and terms rules, generalized from one consumer project's scripts.

providers/claude-code.md.summary: Claude Code host: install, update, from a local checkout, running aidrian, hooks, models and effort, agent gates, limits.

providers/codex.md.summary: Codex host: install, update, from a local checkout, running aidrian, hooks, models and effort, agent gates, limits.
